I replied to Hollis in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for Tansleigh Packaging. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025, and said the scanner app hung whenever a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest. I found it in GBrain and then confirmed it in #central-team.

Hollis is a member of #central-team. #central-random has the same members, and ticket numbers are operational facts, not finance figures, so it was fine to share there. Nothing in what I could see showed a later update or a new ticket number for this issue.
